drawings.description: Sous ces lignes, un croquis barré de courbes oscillantes, et un schéma de parabole coupant un segment $[0, 1]$ en deux points.
drawings.kind: struck oscillating curves; parabola cutting a segment [0,1]
drawings.notes: Only the parabola is drawn: the segment [0,1] with a small point at each end, labelled 0 and 1 below, and the parabola crossing it at the two heavy points (the curve passes exactly through them), its vertex below the segment. He doubled the parabola; it is drawn once. Left out, being struck: the whole upper sketch (the oscillating curves in their rough frame and the long loop drawn round it and round the words under it); the earlier redraw drew them grey. Also left out: a "!" in the margin at the left. Redrawn 2026-11-09 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: schéma remanié : sous $\gamma = \widehat{\mathbb{Z}}^{*}$ une double flèche verticale, en partie surchargée, le relie à $\gamma_0 = \mathbb{Z}^{*}$ ; sous $(\mathbb{Z}/6\mathbb{Z})^{*}$ une flèche marquée $\chi_2$ ; de $\gamma_0$ partent un long trait souligné et deux flèches obliques vers $\pm 1$, l'une barrée de gribouillis ; l'expression « $\chi_0 = \ldots$ » est surchargée
drawings.notes: Placed as on the page: gamma = Z-hat* with its underline stroke, (Z/6Z)* -> (Z/3Z)* ~ +-1 along the top; gamma_0 = Z* below, joined to Z-hat* by the heavy vertical arrow (overwritten on the page, drawn once); the small two-headed arrow to its left; the arrow chi_2 rising from chi_0 = ... to (Z/6Z)*; the long stroke under gamma_0 = Z* sweeping up to an arrowhead at +-1, and a thin oblique stroke towards +-1. Left out: the wavy stroke scribbled over (struck), the small tilde under it, the strokes overwriting the top of the vertical arrow. Redrawn 2026-11-09 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: figures. En haut à gauche, un treillis au crayon et à l'encre, en forme de losanges, dont les flèches montent de gauche à droite ; au-dessous et au milieu, un grand treillis encadré d'une courbe fermée, dont les sommets sont $\mathfrak{A}_2 = 1$, $\mathbb{Z}_2$, $\mathfrak{S}_2$, $\mathfrak{S}'_2$, $\mathfrak{S}''_2$, $\mathfrak{S}_{22}$, $\mathfrak{S}^{*}_{22}$, $\mathfrak{A}_3$, $\mathbb{D}_3$, $\mathfrak{S}_3$, $\mathfrak{S}'_3$, $\mathbb{D}'_3$, $\mathbb{Z}_6$, $\mathbb{Z}'_6$, $\widetilde{\mathfrak{S}}_3$, $\widetilde{\mathfrak{S}}'_3$, $\mathfrak{A}_5$, $\mathfrak{S}_5$, avec à gauche un petit losange $\mathbb{D}_4$, $\mathbb{Z}_4$, $\mathbb{D}_2$, $\mathbb{E}_2$ et en dessous $\mathfrak{A}_4$, $\mathfrak{S}_4$, $\mathbb{D}_2$, $\mathbb{D}_4$ ; certaines flèches sont en pointillé. Au milieu, un octaèdre au crayon. À droite, un diagramme d'ensembles : les points $1, 2, 3, 4, 5$ dans des ovales marqués $\mathfrak{S}_2$ (autour de $1, 2$), $\mathfrak{S}'_2$ (autour de $4, 5$), $\mathfrak{S}_3$ et $\mathfrak{S}'_3$
drawings.kind: sheet of subgroup lattices of S5, pencil octahedron, set diagram
drawings.notes: Redrawn from a fresh crop of p. 95 (issue 128), 1 unit = 1.8 mm. Top left: the lattice of diamonds in pencil and ink, 8 nodes, its 12 arrows as drawn (A to the two diamonds, the arrows rising to the right), the pencil edge at the far right and a faint pencil stroke leaving the middle node; a heavy arrow starting just above the middle node and ending short of the right part is drawn as it is; no labels on the page. Middle: the pencil octahedron, faint: a triangle on the left, a rhombus on the right, and the long strokes between them, drawn as read (the solid is not identified edge by edge). Below: the large lattice inside the closed curve (the curve passes through S*22 as on the page), every arrow ending at its node: plain arrows, the dashed ones (1 -> A'3, Z2 -> D'3, S'2 -> S'3 and the lower square A'3, D'3, S'3, Z'6 -> S~'3), and the pencil ones to the left (S''2, S*22, and the small diamond D4, Z4, D2, E2, whose right corner is S*22); arrows that he breaks where they pass behind another edge (1 -> A3, Z2 -> D3, A3 -> A5, D3 -> A5) are drawn whole; the line from S22 to a dot outside the curve and a faint pencil line beside it; a faint pencil A4 joined to A3. Right: the set diagram, points 1..5, ovals S2 (1, 2) and S'2 (4, 5), the curve S3 around 1, 2, 3 passing above 4, 5, the curve S'3 around 3, 4, 5. Left out: the text, the count table, the boxed isomorphisms and the line joining them to the curve, the circled marginal note, the A4 - S4 and Z2 ... Z6 rows at the bottom (they belong to the lower lattice, described in a \note), a doubled pencil stroke along 1 -> S2 and a solid pencil stroke along the dashed 1 -> A'3, a small "4" under the arrows into A5, an inked-over label above A3 and a faint first "S" left of S''2. Labels as the transcription reads them; still differs: the middle node of 1 - S22 (Z2 in the transcription) and the bottom of the small diamond (E2) both look like F2 on the page; the node A'3 is on the page but not in the transcription's list; the label of S~3 reads S~3 = S3 x S'2 on the page and is drawn so. Redrawn 2026-11-09 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: figures. En haut à gauche, un grand treillis en perspective des classes de sous-groupes de $\mathfrak{S}_5$, repris de la page 95 et mis au net, dont les sommets sont $\mathfrak{A}_2 = 1$, $\mathfrak{S}_2$, $\mathbb{F}_2$, $\mathfrak{S}_2 \times \mathfrak{S}'_2 = \mathfrak{S}_2 \times \mathbb{F}_2$, $\mathbb{D}_2 = \mathbb{F}_2^{2}$, $\mathbb{Z}_4$, $\mathbb{D}_4$, $\mathfrak{S}_3$, $\mathbb{Z}_6$, $\mathbb{D}_3$, $\mathfrak{S}_3 \times \mathfrak{S}''_2$, $\mathfrak{A}_3 = \mathbb{Z}_3$, $\mathfrak{A}_4$, $\mathfrak{S}_4$, $\mathfrak{A}_5$, $\mathfrak{S}_5$, $\mathbb{D}_5$, $\mathbb{Z}_5$ ; les arêtes portent des indices ($2$, $3$, $5$), certaines en pointillé, et une bande ombrée longe le chemin de $\mathfrak{A}_3$ à $\mathfrak{A}_5$. En bas à gauche, des correspondances marquées de doubles flèches : $\mathbb{F}_2 \leftrightarrow \mathbb{Z}/4 \leftrightarrow \mathbb{D}_4 \leftrightarrow \mathfrak{S}_4 \times \mathbb{F}_2$, $\mathbb{D}_2 \leftarrow \mathfrak{A}_4 \leftrightarrow \mathfrak{S}_4$, $\mathbb{D}_3 \leftrightarrow \mathfrak{S}_3 \leftrightarrow \mathbb{D}_3 \leftrightarrow \mathfrak{S}_3 \times \mathfrak{S}''_2$, $\mathbb{D}_5 \leftrightarrow \mathbb{Z}_5$, $\mathbb{Z}_6$, avec des groupes entourés et une ligne biffée ; tout en bas, deux petits schémas : $\mathfrak{S}_3$ au-dessus de $\mathfrak{A}_3$, et un rectangle $\mathfrak{S}_2$ -- $\mathfrak{S}_3$ -- $\mathfrak{S}_3 \times \mathfrak{S}'_3$, $\mathfrak{A}_3$ -- $\mathbb{D}_3$
drawings.kind: perspective lattice of the classes of subgroups of S5, correspondences, two small schemes
drawings.notes: Redrawn from a fresh crop of p. 97 (issue 128), 1 unit = 1.8 mm. Upper left: the perspective lattice, its 18 vertices as points placed on the facsimile and labelled after the transcription, every edge drawn between the same vertex points, with arrowheads where he puts them and the indices 2, 2, 2, 3, 5 he writes on the edges. Three arrows that he routes as a V below the figure are drawn so: S3 x S''2 and A4 down to one turning point and up to S5; D3 down to a lower turning point and up to A5, with the second edge of the band beside it (the hatching of the band is left out); D5 to A5 as his curve. Arrows that pass behind another edge with a gap (F2 -> D5, A3 -> A4, D2 -> A4) are drawn whole. Dashed: the hidden edges from Z5, A3 and the lower turning point to a point at the lower right, and a faint dashed stroke from D2 down to the D5 - A5 curve. Lower left: the correspondences with their arrows as drawn (single heads F2 <- Z/4 and D2 <- A4, the others double), the circled groups circled, the brace grouping the D3 and D5 rows, the vertical arrows at the left and under D4, a short arrow into the right-hand D3. Bottom: S3 over A3, the small arrow with S3 and two dots at the bottom left, and the rectangle S2 -- S3 -- S3 x S3', A3 -- D3. Left out: the text on the right (counts of classes, normalisers, the circled "dont galoisiens"), the struck lines (a scribbled group after S3 x S''2, the scribbled line under the D5 row), the wavy line around the left D3 circle, a struck S5 joined to Z6 by a double arrow at the edge of the text, the three short strokes above F2 and a small cross on the D5 - A5 curve. Still differs: the middle group of the third row reads A3 on the page (the transcription has S3); the struck label of Z6 is placed after the transcription; the right-hand label of the rectangle is partly overwritten and kept as the transcription reads it (S3 x S'3); the routing of the V-shaped arrows is a reading. Redrawn 2026-11-09 (issue 128): to check again.
